task.name: open_lid_place_filter
task.description: Use the left arm to open the rice cooker lid, then use the right arm to place the filter inside.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the rice cooker lid.
2. Grasp the rice cooker lid with the left arm.
3. Open the rice cooker lid using the left arm.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the filter.
5. Grasp the filter with the right arm.
6. Move the right arm to align with the open rice cooker.
7. Release the gripper to place the filter inside the rice cooker.
